trace.notes: Normalized a single URL input: https://zbmath.org/5919703.
Direct fetch of https://zbmath.org/5919703 returned HTTP 403, so the zbMATH Open API was queried for document id 5919703.

zbMATH API identified the source as Wataru Takahashi, titled Nonlinear mappings in equilibrium problems and an open problem in fixed point theory, a serial article in Proceedings of the 9th international conference on fixed point theory and its applications, pages 177-197, 2010. The record exposed no DOI and no full-text links.

Failure mode: metadata_only after a blocked resolver page. Exact-work recovery searches used the exact title plus PDF, the exact title alone, the exact title plus Yokohama, the title fragment plus page range, and the proceedings title plus page range. Candidate pages inspected or rejected included later Springer and SpringerOpen articles that cite the work, later open-access papers about related fixed point problems, and search results containing only bibliographic references or snippets. None provided a readable PDF or HTML full text of the same exact work.
Input could not be normalized to a readable PDF or HTML full-text source without switching to a different work or extracting from metadata, citation records, or search snippets.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/5919703.json and outputs/latest.json.
